problems.title: Fix Palindrome & Whitespace Bug
problems.description: The given function is supposed to check if strings are palindromes ignoring case and spaces. Fix the logic and index bounds error to produce the expected output.
problems.starterCode:
# Bug Hunt Challenge: Palindrome Checker
# Fix the bugs so the output matches the expected output:
# Race car -> YES
# madam -> YES
# hello -> NO

def is_palindrome(s):
    # BUG 1: Case conversion missed
    cleaned = ""
    for ch in s:
        if ch.isalnum():
            cleaned += ch  # Bug: should normalize case

    # BUG 2: Off-by-one error in manual reversal
    left = 0
    right = len(cleaned) # BUG: should be len(cleaned) - 1

    while left < right:
        if cleaned[left] != cleaned[right]:
            return False
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    return True

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_words = ["Race car", "madam", "hello"]
    for word in test_words:
        print("YES" if is_palindrome(word) else "NO")
